title: Anonymous crowd report
description: One anonymised report of the water on the ground where the reporter is right now. The plan's exact field set from assam-flood-implementation-plan.md PART 3 §3.5, plus a schema_version per the repo-wide rule that every artifact carries one (schemas/README.md). No PII of any kind is permitted: no name, phone, email, full-precision coordinate, or raw device token.

report_id.description: UUID assigned at intake. The raw device token is never persisted or transmitted; only the salted, monthly-rotating device_hash is.

submitted_at.description: Reporter's local wall-clock time of submission with the IST offset.

location.description: [longitude, latitude] rounded to three decimal degrees (about 100 m at Assam latitudes), never finer than the 50 m policy floor declared by location_precision_m. Matches the plan example 'location: [94.681, 26.912]'.

location_precision_m.description: The deliberate coarsening policy floor. The stored grid is coarser than this and never finer; consumers must read this to know the data is deliberately coarse.

locality_id.description: Optional resolve-to-revenue-circle. Null when the reporter did not pick a locality.

device_hash.description: Salted, monthly-rotating SHA-256 of the raw device token. Used only for duplicate detection. Not reversible to a device, not linkable across monthly rotations.

flags.description: Display-rule flags grind. A flagged report is kept for review and never auto-deleted.
